description: Header file defining the 'ptrs_uplink_config' structure and related nested structures for configuring UL PTRS in 5G NR, including parameters for CP-OFDM and DFT-s-OFDM waveforms, with references to 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: ptrs_uplink_config
classes.description: Structure representing UL PTRS configuration with optional nested configurations for transform precoder disabled and enabled states.

classes.name: ptrs_uplink_config::transform_precoder_disabled
classes.description: Configuration parameters for UL PTRS without transform precoder (CP-OFDM).

classes.name: ptrs_uplink_config::transform_precoder_enabled
classes.description: Configuration parameters for UL PTRS with transform precoder (DFT-s-OFDM).
